RANG Restaurant
Sep 2026 • Couples
I visited Rang restaurant and tried a selection of its Indian dishes, and the experience was enjoyable. The tandoori chicken was perfectly seasoned and grilled to its original recipe, while the butter chicken had a creamy and flavorful sauce. The chicken masala had a balanced spiciness and suited lovers of mildly spicy flavor.

As for the rice, the biryani was fragrant and the grains were fluffy, and the lemon rice was light and refreshing and complemented the heavy dishes wonderfully.

I would like to give special thanks to employee Aga for her outstanding service. She was kind, smiling, and quick in fulfilling requests, and she helped us choose the dishes. Her service added a lot to the beauty of the experience.
I recommend it to anyone who loves Indian cuisine, and I will definitely come back again.
